verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a data-export capability. Kino offers no documented export of projects, timelines, transcripts or metadata to open formats (such as EDL, XML or OTIO) that would let a user take everything and leave. The closest items are sharing a package of assets and playing camera-native formats on import; both are adjacent features, not a documented full-data export path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
